description: This class includes the manufacture of sporting and athletic goods (except apparel and footwear).
includes: manufacture of articles and equipment for sports, outdoor and indoor games: footballs, basketballs, rackets, golf clubs, skis, tennis balls
manufacture of gymnasium, athletics and other sports equipment: rowing machines, exercise bikes, treadmills
manufacture of whips and riding crops
manufacture of fishing rods and fishing tackle
manufacture of skates (ice and roller), skis, snowboards, surfboards
excludes: manufacture of toy sports equipment, see 3240
manufacture of sports vehicles (cars, motorcycles, bicycles), see respective classes
